title: Sheafification of a presheaf of modules over a presheaf of rings
statement: Let $X$ be a topological space, and consider presheaves and sheaves on the open subsets of $X$, a family of opens covering $U$ when its union is $U$. Let $\mathcal O$ be a presheaf of commutative rings on $X$ with sheafification $\theta_{\mathcal O}:\mathcal O\to\mathcal O^\#$ as a presheaf of commutative rings [def-weil-pbc-sheafification], and let $\mathcal P$ be a presheaf of $\mathcal O$-modules [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification], with sheafification $\theta_{\mathcal P}:\mathcal P\to\mathcal P^\#$ as a presheaf of abelian groups. Then there is a structure of sheaf of $\mathcal O^\#$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] on the abelian sheaf $\mathcal P^\#$ such that $\theta_{\mathcal P}$ is semilinear over $\theta_{\mathcal O}$: $\theta_{\mathcal P,U}(ax)=\theta_{\mathcal O,U}(a)\,\theta_{\mathcal P,U}(x)$ for $U\subseteq X$ open, $a\in\mathcal O(U)$, $x\in\mathcal P(U)$; that is, $\theta_{\mathcal P}$ is a morphism of presheaves of $\mathcal O$-modules into $\mathcal P^\#$ regarded as an $\mathcal O$-module through $\theta_{\mathcal O}$. Moreover, for every sheaf of $\mathcal O^\#$-modules $\mathcal N$, regarded as a presheaf of $\mathcal O$-modules through $\theta_{\mathcal O}$, every morphism of presheaves of $\mathcal O$-modules $\varphi:\mathcal P\to\mathcal N$ factors uniquely as $\varphi=\bar\varphi\circ\theta_{\mathcal P}$ with $\bar\varphi:\mathcal P^\#\to\mathcal N$ a morphism of sheaves of $\mathcal O^\#$-modules; $\bar\varphi$ is the morphism of abelian sheaves given by the universal property of $\theta_{\mathcal P}$. Hence $\varphi\mapsto\bar\varphi$ is a bijection $\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathrm{PMod}(\mathcal O)}(\mathcal P,\mathcal N)\cong\operatorname{Hom}_{\Mod(\mathcal O^\#)}(\mathcal P^\#,\mathcal N)$, natural in $\mathcal P$ and $\mathcal N$ (a morphism $\mathcal P\to\mathcal P'$ of presheaves of $\mathcal O$-modules giving its sheafification, an $\mathcal O^\#$-linear map).
